title: Generative AI for Computer Vision - Week 10 Assignment 10
subject: Generative AI for Computer Vision

questions.question: 1. What is the main purpose of a Large Language Model (LLM)?
options: To understand and generate human-like text
To remove all text from a dataset
questions.correctAnswer: To understand and generate human-like text
questions.explanation: An LLM is trained to process and generate text by learning patterns and relationships in large amounts of language data.

questions.question: 2. Which architecture is commonly used to build modern Large Language Models?
questions.explanation: Modern LLMs commonly use the Transformer architecture because it can efficiently model relationships between tokens in a sequence.

questions.question: 3. What is the purpose of tokenization in an LLM?
options: To convert text into smaller units that the model can process
To convert text directly into images
questions.correctAnswer: To convert text into smaller units that the model can process
questions.explanation: Tokenization converts text into tokens, such as words, subwords, or characters, which can then be converted into numerical representations for the model.

questions.question: 4. What is the main purpose of pre-training an LLM?
options: To train only on one image
To learn general patterns from a large amount of text data
questions.correctAnswer: To learn general patterns from a large amount of text data
questions.explanation: During pre-training, an LLM learns general language patterns, relationships, and knowledge from a large collection of text data.

questions.question: 5. What is fine-tuning in an LLM?
options: Further training a pre-trained model for a specific task or domain
questions.correctAnswer: Further training a pre-trained model for a specific task or domain
questions.explanation: Fine-tuning adapts a pre-trained model to perform better on a particular task, dataset, or domain.

questions.question: 6. What is the main purpose of a Vision-Language Model (VLM)?
options: To understand information from both images and language
questions.correctAnswer: To understand information from both images and language
questions.explanation: VLMs combine visual and language information so that the model can understand relationships between images and text.

questions.question: 7. What is the role of the Vision Encoder in a VLM?
options: To extract useful features from images
questions.correctAnswer: To extract useful features from images
questions.explanation: The Vision Encoder converts an input image into visual feature representations that can be used by the multimodal model.

questions.question: 8. What is the purpose of Vision-Language Alignment?
options: To align visual and textual representations in a common representation space
To train only the language encoder
To convert all images into audio
questions.correctAnswer: To align visual and textual representations in a common representation space
questions.explanation: Vision-language alignment helps the model learn meaningful relationships between visual features and their corresponding textual representations.

questions.question: 9. What is the main purpose of Cross-Modal Attention in a VLM?
options: To allow information from one modality to interact with another modality
questions.correctAnswer: To allow information from one modality to interact with another modality
questions.explanation: Cross-modal attention allows information from one modality, such as vision, to influence the processing of another modality, such as language.

questions.question: 10. What is Contrastive Learning used for in Vision-Language Models?
options: To learn similar representations for matching image-text pairs
To train only an image classifier
questions.correctAnswer: To learn similar representations for matching image-text pairs
questions.explanation: Contrastive learning encourages matching image-text pairs to have similar representations while separating unrelated image-text pairs.
